dedupe_keys.name: code for thresholds in road network functioning on us atlantic and gulf barrier islands

description: Environmental Dynamics Lab researchers publish Python analysis of flood-driven connectivity loss on United States barrier-island roads. The Zenodo software archive corresponds to GitHub tag v1.0.0, where the MIT licence was verified. Scripts combine OSMnx roads, CUDEM elevations and extreme-water-level estimates from NOAA stations, then remove exposed nodes and measure network change. These calculations support coastal transport-resilience simulations. Related G6 data-us-barrier-island-road-network-flood-threshold-data supplies prepared graphs, and catalogue model-osmnx supplies network extraction tools. Coverage is selected Atlantic and Gulf barrier islands, not all coastal roads. Rebuilding requires substantial external elevation data, and the README lists legacy Python and dependency versions whose compatibility remains uncertain. Terrain and water-level assumptions affect thresholds. No code was installed, data reconstructed or results reproduced.
